note: Georgia (Government ordinance under the Law on Legal Status of Aliens of 2014, as amended): nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for a year, 90 days, 45 (Iran) or 30 (China, Hong Kong, Macao); those on the e-Visa lists apply online (90 days in 180, or 30 in 120). Kosovo's, Palestine's and Taiwan's passports are refused (visas case by case: taken as a visa); everyone else needs a visa (holders of certain third-country visas or residences may enter for 90 in 180: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against Government Ordinance No 255 of 5 June 2015 and its amendments on Matsne, which confirmed the one-year list (Jordan added in 2017, Ukraine's full year restored in 2025) and China's 30 days for tourism; its row 28 is the Dominican Republic, not Dominica, which Wikipedia's copy had listed, so Dominica was moved to a visa. The 90- and 45-day stays, Hong Kong's and Macao's, and the e-Visa lists rest on other acts not read and stand on Wikipedia's copy.
